QUOTE: "| `code` | ... | No. Only restarting the MCP client clears it |" and "`data` ... Can a rebuild fix it? Yes" and "If the index is newer, a rebuild re-stamps the same newer version and cannot clear it"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes which axes a rebuild can or cannot fix, but never states that separate axes need different actions and that this is why a single flag would not have sufficed.
